title: ResilienceHubView
description: Polymorphic hub projection for a content item. Lists every hub (dwelling / collective / computed) known to hold at least one replica of the content, derived from peer_blob_inventory (gossip operational) cross-referenced with peer-identity bindings (DHT Category-A). Hub is a *role*, not a notarized entity — kind classification is a projection-layer concern. Operational Category C — no DHT entry.

contentId.description: The content item whose hub distribution is described.

hubs.description: Zero or more hubs known to hold replicas. Empty when the content is unknown or has no inventory records.
